docstring:
Returns the depth of an object (specified by a bounding box) in meters.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    float: The depth of the object specified by the coordinates in meters.

Returns the width and height of the object in 2D pixel space.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    tuple: (width, height) of the object in 2D pixel space.

Returns the color of an object specified by a bounding box.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    string: The color of the object.

Returns the bounding box of the object with the closest depth among a list of bounding boxes.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bboxes (list): A list of bounding boxes [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax].

Returns:
    list: The bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] of the object with the closest depth.

Counts the number of objects in an image that match a given object prompt.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of object to count.

Returns:
    int: The number of objects matching the prompt.
